description.value: Terra Nostra Guest Ranch sits on the shores of Clearwater Lake in the remote Chilcotin, accessible off Highway 20 between Williams Lake and Bella Coola near Tweedsmuir Provincial Park. The property offers a range of rustic accommodation from a renovated log saddle cabin to campsites and a wilderness cabin, with a strong focus on horseback riding, backcountry hiking, canoeing, and winter activities including ski touring and heli-skiing. The ranch markets primarily to German-speaking European travellers seeking a wilderness ranch experience far from tourist crowds.
